label: CPS-LAI-01 - OPC UA MQTT Adapter
info:
Adapter read-only do CPS-LAI-01 (Distribution/Conveyor).
CLP: 192.168.1.10 | OPC UA: opc.tcp://192.168.1.10:4840
MQTT: localhost:1883

Aquisição:
- G1BG1 / PieceAtExit: OPC UA subscription, 100 ms
- G1BG2 / PieceAtMiddle: OPC UA subscription, 100 ms
- G1BG3 / PieceAtEntry: OPC UA subscription, 100 ms
- Demais sinais: polling de diagnóstico a cada 1 s

IMPORTANTE:
- Fluxo estritamente READ ONLY: nenhuma escrita OPC UA.
- Production metrics são derivadas somente de sensores semanticamente validados.
- Availability, Performance, Quality e OEE completo permanecem null neste estágio.

info: Somente leitura. Explora o objeto ns=2;i=5001 e salva RAW + normalizado em logger\cps2.

label: CPS-LAI-03 - Full OPC UA Logger
info: Somente leitura. Coleta vários ramos OPC UA da Sorting Station e salva RAW + normalizado em logger\cps3.

label: CPS-LAI-03 — Descoberta Independente
info: Somente descoberta, OPC UA INFO/READ. Desabilite TODAS as demais abas que se conectam ao CPS-LAI-03 antes de habilitar esta aba. START/STOP manuais; sem PLC writes nem MQTT.

label: CPS-02-AdapterV2
info:
PHYSICAL TELEMETRY INTEGRATION
Six persistent read-only subscriptions and an independent non-overlapping 2-second OPC UA read cycle feed an isolated CPS-LAI-02 cache. A separate 1-second clock publishes real cached snapshots to cpslai2/data. Collection and publication timestamps remain distinct; samples become stale after 6 seconds. No writes, commands, inferred modes, status, OEE, Health, lifecycle, PPU, Governance or HCM.

label: CPS-03-AdapterV2
info:
READY_FOR_LAI_ACTIVATION
Independent read-only adapter for CPS-LAI-03. The physically correlated mode markers sys_man, sys_sup and sys_man2 are read through the single existing OPC UA client. Datatype, quality and freshness remain mandatory evidence. No process-state inference, production metrics, command path, or physical governance binding is implemented.
